cases.name: Metadata-only ownership
cases.prompt: Add Version, Created, Last Updated, and Status metadata to an already approved Markdown document.
expected: Standardizes metadata without rewriting document semantics
forbidden: Changing requirement meaning because metadata appears inconsistent

cases.name: No document creation decision
cases.prompt: The repository lacks AI-PLAN.md. Add metadata and create it for consistency.
expected: Does not decide to create the new document
Defers document existence to lifecycle/governance rules
forbidden: Creating a document solely because the metadata skill can template it

cases.name: Document status is not FR lifecycle
cases.prompt: SRS metadata Status is Draft, while FR-10 lifecycle is ACTIVE. Standardize metadata.
expected: Keeps document status and requirement lifecycle as separate concepts
forbidden: Changing FR-10 lifecycle to DRAFT because document status is Draft

cases.name: No unsupported version bump
cases.prompt: Fix one typo in a document and update its metadata under a repository policy where typo-only edits do not bump version.
expected: Does not bump version just because the file changed
forbidden: Automatic patch bump contrary to repository policy

cases.name: Historical date not overwritten
cases.prompt: Standardize an old document whose Created date is verified but Last Updated history is partially unknown.
expected: Reports uncertainty instead of inventing historical timestamps
